scripts.engine:test: make -C engine test || mingw32-make -C engine test
scripts.dev:servers: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev: npm run engine:build && npm run dev:servers
scripts.setup:all: npm install && npm run engine:build && npm run engine:test
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,API_TEST -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on tcp:4000 && npm run test:backend"
scripts.run:all: npm run setup:all && npm run dev:all
